top_reviews.content: I always walked past this place but never went in till recently. The food is superb, the service is excellent, the location is very convenient with large windows and calming music. The salmon teriyaki is one of the best I've had. It's not super cheap but is very reasonably priced for what it is. Highly recommended!

Probably one of the best sushi places I have ever visited in the Bay. I'm taking out a star because the wait was way TOO long. We ordered 2 miso soups, 2 rolls, and some nigiris. It took more than 40 minutes to arrive, and everything came at different times, which is disappointing if you want to enjoy the dishes together. I will come back, but definitely not on weekends.

The hot noodle is really good. What makes it good is the broth. They make the broth with bonito flakes, mackerel, and kelp daily.  So it is really tasty.   Thanks he rolls are alright. They have a new chef making them so it was taking a very long time to make (45 min).   I’ll come back for the hot noodle.

Best Japanese food in the East Bay, in my opinion. Everything on the menu is delicious, and the husband-and-wife team that owns and operates Mitama works very hard to maintain the highest standard of quality.  Our experience eating here is consistently superb.
Omakase was decent and ramen soup was tasty.  Could have better ramen noodles but overall good experience.  That ramen pepper is epic.  Kaki fry definitely a good crunch and suffiently sized oysters.

top_reviews.content: Don Blanc was absolutely amazing! The meat was incredibly tender, juicy, and full of flavor, and every dish we ordered was delicious. The quality of the food was outstanding, and the service was friendly and attentive. This is easily one of the best Korean BBQ restaurants I’ve been to. I’ll definitely be coming back—highly recommended!

Don Blanc is a place where you can enjoy top-notch service, fresh meat, and side dishes. The authentic, un-Americanized Korean food is truly delicious, and the servers are incredibly friendly. In particular, the two managers, John and Chris, never forget to provide what customers need, even though they're busy, and they always have a smile on their face, making for a comfortable and enjoyable dining experience. Their delightful sense of humor always makes me happy. If I could, I'd love to visit this place often. If you're craving authentic Korean barbecue, Korean beer, and delicious Korean side dishes, this is a restaurant I highly recommend.

The quality of the meat was outstanding. We ordered Beef Set B, and every cut was incredibly fresh, tender, and flavorful. The jumulleok was especially good, with just the right amount of seasoning and a great savory, umami flavor. We also ordered samgyeopsal (pork belly), which had the perfect meat-to-fat ratio and was delicious. As a Korean I’ve been to many Korean BBQ restaurants, including Michelin-rated K-BBQ spots, and this place is honestly right up there with them.

The owner and staff were also incredibly friendly and welcoming. The doenjang jjigae (soybean paste stew) tasted very authentic, the pork jowl‘s texture was perfect, and the naengmyeon (cold noodles) had such a great depth of flavor and umami.

Overall, it was an extremely satisfying meal, and I’ll definitely be coming back often.

진짜 너무 맛있었어요~!! 항정살 정말 쫄깃하고 맛있어요 강추

GOPCHANG LOVER’S PARADISE
If you’ve been missing your Korean Gopchang/intestines you had in SoCal, this is the spot to try! The portion is decent and flavor is there! Also love that there’s potato slices in there!

To avoid long lines, come during off hours like 3pm~ They don’t take same day reservations.

Other dishes-
Cold buckwheat noodles are 9/10
Soy sauce garlic chicken 7/10 (wish they weren’t full of fried batter clumps and wanted just wings)
Pork belly single serving 9/10
Spicy tofu soup 8.5/10 (love the tofu in there!)
Side dishes 8/10

Atmosphere-
Very loud and the music just adds to the noise, have to yell across the table for my friends to hear me, vise versa…. During busy hours that is.

Ate here and ordered the beef set, a plate of beef intestine, and corn cheese. The beef quality was good, but most of the meats ended up tasting pretty similar. The side dishes were also below average compared to other Korean BBQ restaurants I’ve been to.

We had three people, but they only provided two dipping sauces, which was a bit odd. The beef intestine was especially disappointing in terms of value, $35 for a very small plate.

Overall, the restaurant felt overpriced, averaging about $83 per person, and I don’t think the quality justified the cost.

One thing to note: parking on the nearby streets can be risky. Our car was broken into while we were eating (there was nothing at all inside the car), so I’d recommend being extra cautious or choosing a more secure parking option.

That said, I’ve heard their pork is the better choice, so it might be worth trying that instead if you decide to visit.

My mom and I decided to try this place together while in SF and were pleasantly surprised by the quality and authenticity of the food! My mom grew up in Burma and normally isn’t very impressed with the food in the bay but she said she would come back to try more!

Fantastic hole-in-the-wall with friendly service and tasty food! Not a lot of space so you may have to wait for a table, and quite honestly the seating is not all that comfortable. Despite the seating issues, I still had an exceptional experience so that is noteworthy.

Delicious and friendly little place. Ordered two things, and both were delicious. For the beef curry, the potato is fried and then added to the curry. This nice little touch showed their attention to detail.

top_reviews.content:
Excellent tacos, fresh ceviche and great margaritas near Telegraph Ave in Berkeley

We arrived in Berkeley on a Sunday and after hearing many great recommendations from local students, we decided to visit 5 Tacos & Beers. Even though the restaurant was quite busy when we arrived, the place is spacious and there were still several tables available. The hosts welcomed us with a smile and allowed us to choose our own table, which immediately created a relaxed and friendly atmosphere.

Once seated, we started with the Mix Ceviche, which was very fresh, bright, and full of flavor. The citrus marinade was perfectly balanced and paired nicely with the crisp tortilla chips served on the side.

For the main dishes we ordered Quesabirrias (one pollo and one carne) with a cup of consommé, plus an order of fish tacos, and a skinny margarita. Everything was excellent. The quesabirrias were crispy on the outside, filled with tender meat and melted cheese, and dipping them into the consommé added a deep, rich flavor. The fish tacos were light and well seasoned, with fresh toppings that complemented the fish perfectly.

Service throughout the meal was friendly and attentive. The staff checked in regularly and everything was served quickly. One thing we really enjoyed was being able to see the open kitchen and the chefs preparing dishes nonstop as orders came in.

The restaurant itself is clean, colorful, and nicely designed, with a full bar and a relaxed Berkeley vibe. Parking can be found on nearby streets, but the easiest option is using a paid garage nearby so you don’t have to worry about time limits.

After eating, it’s also great to walk around the neighborhood and explore Telegraph Avenue, which is full of interesting shops, street art, and student energy.

Overall, a great spot for tacos, ceviche, and margaritas in Berkeley. Highly recommended. 🌮🍹

I walked by this place for years underestimating it. The tacos are special: great tortillas, flavorful ingredients, and generous portions. The beer and cocktail selection is great too.  Today, I had the chilaquiles and it was crisp, spicy and delicious.  They have plenty of room for a group and service is great.

Very tastey! I ordered the Mexican avocado toast. Asked for salsa on the side and no pickled onions. They came to the table to clarify that the salsa had onions in it and asked if I wanted it since I said no onions. I said it in the salsa was fine. I just didnt want pickled onions. When my food came there was so salsa. Miscommunication purhaps however everything was excellent other wise!

This is a must try! Walking in the vibe is great and clean! Service is unbelievable!! Now the the food is out of this world from
The home made tortillas to the steak this place a must try. Will definitely add this place to our regular spots
Everything was absolutely delicious. The water, the aguas frescas, the tacos, everything! Service was good, vibe was good. I would recommend 10/10

top_reviews.content:
Best pizza slices in the entire Bay Area!

I was referred to this place by numerous people so I had to give it a try… had an excursion with my son and we wanted to grab something quick so we stopped here for a slice of Za.

First off, the store is very casual with abundant seating and second, the staff is very friendly and quick.

As for the slices, they were fantastic! The pizza dough is firm with a slight crisp to it and the toppings are all organic and top notch quality. I ordered a cheese slice for my kid and a couple Sweet Little Piggy’s for myself. The candied bacon is a fantastic touch on the sweet piggy.

Highly recommend this spot!
Super solid pizza. Even better house drinks for$9 a piece. I think I'll come here to work next time

I saw the sign as I was walking by coming back from a job that said that it's $12 for two slices of pizza and fresh lemonade. I thought man with prices these days that's a great deal. So I went inside and I got the pizza and it was hot fresh and delicious with house Maid lemonade not from concentrate. I was absolutely pleased with my pizza and the service I got as well as the facility was a little bit authentic like an old family from Italy cooking pizza right out of the kitchen. If I'm in the area again I will definitely swing by this place is a must-have for Pizza Lovers of all ages

Absolutely swinging for the fences, this small pizzeria, in  Oakland's  cemetery-adjacent Piedmont neighborhood, is now my new favorite Oakland Pizza. With a slice, perfectly calibrating flat dough crunch, with a chewy delicious after effect, sauce that is perfectly acidic and just a tad naturally sweet,  and with high temperature cheese melted perfectly in an actual pizza oven, (you'd be surprised at a lot of places don't really have a new york-style pizza oven, it's a thing) these slices are 10 out of 10 for flavor, texture, and presentation.
Cannot speak highly enough of this local Pizzeria.

Querying Jonathan, the Pizza Chef, (as I am known to do)  it was revealed to me that the dough is allowed to preferment, and is a mix of doughs, perfectly combining the flavor profile of sourdough, with that with a more neutral dough, like a New York slice.
Great pizza, great people, great atmosphere, this tiny place represents what to do right about pizza.
Was absolutely delicious pizza and lemonade for a great deal, 2 slices and a drink for $12! Very kind and great environment :)

top_reviews.content: My husband and I wanted to try Korean fried chicken. 🍗🐔 The place is very clean and The owner was helpful and kind. 😊👍 He helped us choose a few chicken flavors. 🌶️🍯 Absolutely delicious 😋. 💯

I’m just gonna say it: it smelled weird in here. Damp, like a locker room. It wasn’t bad enough to deter us but enough to color the experience negatively — I imagine I’d probably rate this high if I had it for takeout (and, it seems like most people coming in were there for pickup).

Still, sometimes these rough-around-the-edges mom and pop shops can be surprisingly good, and that was true for the Korean fried chicken. Spicy, crispy yet super saucy, and mixed in were these lovely, chewy little rice cake tteokbokkis.

I’d pass on the bibimbap, as the bulgogi was chewier than expected and the oil was a little heavy handed.

I have a feeling I would’ve liked this more after a drunken night out, so perhaps this great Korean spoon is best saved for late nights with friends.

K Soul Chicken is the perfect place for a little Korean fried chicken and snacks pick me up! Their chicken is fried to perfection, and offer so many different flavors. Posted right along Polk St, so it is the perfect place to get the party started over a little beer & casual dinner with friends before hitting up the bars. Aside from the fried chicken, the bbq pork plate and mandu were also delicious and filling. They’ve been serving the community for 35 years, and the owner is so kind and welcoming. Definitely hit them up if you’re in the mood for some delicious KFC & Korean staples.

This place was so delicious! This place was always recommended from our friends. Finally got to try it. We had a kimchi fried rice and the fried chicken was so good. The owner was super nice and he treated us so well we will for sure. Be back our new favorite Korean spot of all time.

If you read hangul, you'll understand that this place specializes in the chicken dishes. The chicken was so tender and amazing. The mandu was homemade and delicious. The sauce for the mandu was perfect, not to much vinegar and not too little. The K dog had so much cheese pull it was astonishing. I'm so glad we chose this place. I can be critical of food from my own culture because I eat a lot of it from various places. This was better than my halmoni makes - just don't tell her I said so.

I hear the tamales are delicious,  but everytime I go there they are either out of the vegetarian options or closed even during listed open hours. At least put up a sign on when you might open the window back up,  if the clapboard is still out.

Visiting from Texas and saw this place as I was driving, so made a U-turn to stop by.

top_reviews.content:
Great location on Broadway near Jack London Square. Does not have a lot of indoor seating. What seating they have is rather eclectic. The tap selection is great. Unfortunately for me about half of the taps were empty. There had recently been a couple of nearby shows so their taps were hit pretty hard. We will definitely go back to try more of their brews.
The pizzas are delicious! Kind of Detroit and grandma style pies. They do it up proper too. The employees are pleasant, professional, and friendly. The decor is heavy metal-death metal with some satanic stuff. Very interesting and cool just be aware if that sort of thing isn't your cup of tea. 😂
They have some great pinball machines in the arcade. It is a lively location.

Heshers has so many fun pizza topping combos! I love something different and it was reallt hard to choose. We settled on the Canadian Tuxedo (blueberry, blue cheese, bacon) and the Coffin's choice (pepperoni, pineapple, bacon, jalapenos) and both were excellent and balanced. The crust itself was also really good, very crispy outside and light. They also have a great selection of beers and ciders and lots of games including pinball in the back!

We passed by Hesher's so many times heading somewhere else in Jack London, so I'm glad we finally stopped there and will be back!

We had such a great experience at Hesher’s Pizza & Taproom! While waiting on our to-go order of the Cheese Master regular pizza, we played a round of Uno from their giant game closet—literally a chest with drawers full of all kinds of games. We even finished our game right as the pizza was brought out to our table!

The atmosphere is awesome—inviting, laid-back, and fun. Between the pool table, pinball machines, and all the board games, there’s something for everyone to enjoy while hanging out.

As for the pizza? Absolutely delicious. The Cheese Master hit the spot, and I loved that they included small sealed packets of red pepper flakes, cheese, and more on the side. Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly made.

The staff was friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better.

Overall, 5 stars across the board. Great food, great atmosphere, and great people. Highly recommend Hesher’s if you’re looking for a fun spot to relax and enjoy top-quality pizza!

This is a cool pizza spot! Metal and pizza go so well together like PB&J, I’m surprised it took this long for someone to make it happen. That’s a compliment not a complaint!

Was there when they had 2 bands playing, and one of the bands me and my buddy went there to see Hedonist; vibe is awesome! Cool spot, and the selection of Pizza is great. They have a pool table, a little corner of arcade and pinball machines which is awesome.

Overall, this is an awesome spot, metalheads and punk rockers will love this spot, and the pizza is definitely worth the price!

I would say that the pizza was created from Satan himself. It was so good I felt like I was doing something wrong. We got the pepperoni honey pizza and it was almost like Detroit style pizza. I always knew that Detroit would be derived from hell. JK but for real this environment is super interesting and is themed on heavy metal. The beer was focused mostly on ciders and was cool that I could get a flight. I would say that if you are cool with something different and are down with metal, show face here. Pro Tip; I saw a couple bring their first date here. I would maybe not do that. Maybe just your homies and play board games. 7.3/10

The family-owned vibe shines through in every detail, from warm greetings to attentive service. The menu features authentic Thai dishes, each bursting with fresh flavors and vibrant spices. The presentation is appealing, and the portions are generous. The ambiance combines a relaxed yet lively feel, perfect for both casual dinners and special occasions. Overall, White Lotus Thai Cousins delivers a memorable dining experience with its friendly staff, delicious food, and charming environment—truly a hidden gem for Thai cuisine lovers looking for a authentic, family-run spot.

Authentic, traditional, local Thai style. The Pad Thai is the best I have had outside of Thailand.

Rare items like the pomelo salad, the steamed fish curry “Hor Mok”, are exceptional.

Can’t find a menu like this outside of Thailand. Warm, friendly Thai staff.

This has been my favorite Thai restaurant for years! I’ve probably had everything on their menu and can say that everything is delicious here. What I love is that everything can be made vegetarian, which is not the case for many other Thai restaurants. Highly recommend a visit :)

I found my favorite Thai Restaurant in Albany, California.   There are many choices in the east bay that are so excellent, and I love some of the other Thai cuisine styles and regional flavors, but the freshness,  blended spice flavors in her special sauces, and beautiful presentation at White Lotus is just superb.   To'i has a gift and her staff are wonderful too.

Unfortunately, we were unimpressed by the food. The three dishes we had were all a bit off. The peanut sauce for the shrimp rolls tasted old. The spicy basil chicken was quite salty. The papaya salad was mostly bean sprouts with hints of papaya.  Altogether the food was not value for money and maybe that’s why the restaurant was mostly empty even on a Friday evening.

The atmosphere is bright and casual, staff are friendly, but usually pretty empty for some reason. Carry out orders are super quick too. We haven’t had a bad dish yet! Would recommend and will be back regularly.

I got this food delivered through DoorDash. Everything was either foul or inedible. The combination chow mein had a hair in it. The pork buns were extremely dry and stale with barely any filling. The sesame chicken was soggy and just tasted like sugar, and the broccoli it came with was raw. Everything smelled and tasted like it had been sitting out all day. I threw it out after a few bites because I am pregnant and I was afraid that I would get food poisoning.

Solo dinner before meeting up with some friends nearby - great place to stop for dinner before going to a concert at Chase Center or a Giants game. Food was hot and fresh, and portions were generous. Felt like I was having dinner at my grandma’s house - a truly homely and cozy meal.

Omg this place was absolutely delicious! Best Chinese food I ever had. The service was great. The family works there and are so kind and cute. I loved it! Highly recommend

People need to avoid this establishment because they don’t give a single damn about their customers.

I ordered on ClassPass and I drove 30 minutes to go pick up my food. My pick up time was for 6:25 and I got there at 6:20 and they were fully closed.

I looked on ClassPass and realized that this has been going on for three months and about a dozen people have had the exact same issue.

When I reached out to them directly, they told me that I can reach out to ClassPass for a refund, and that they “have no control over it”. In reality, they have not bothered to lift a finger to adjust their schedule online so it’s accurate and that this stops happening to people, despite a dozen reviews of people having the exact same issue.

I wasted an hour overall driving there, and they wouldn’t even offer me a courtesy gift card or anything like that, claiming that they couldn’t do anything since this was ClassPass. This is not a valid excuse. Every establishment has authority to offer courtesy to their customers when they make mistakes that are 100% their own fault. Getting my credits back is not going to account for the hour of time that I wasted, which could’ve easily been avoided if they had paid any attention to all of the people that I’ve complained about the same thing.

What’s worse is that their chat representative was using ChatGPT to respond to me.

Again, this establishment clearly has very little regard for their customers. I won’t be going back and I’ll definitely tell people to stay clear of this place.

This place was lowkey so awesome. Ive been walking by its unopened storefront for a while now and im happy to see it open. everything is under $11 dollars (plus there is a student discount), and they have many high protein and healthy options for quick grab and go!! I only paid $9 for a tasty chicken pasta with 39g of protein. I think they are a little confused right now bc it’s literally their first day open, but i’m sure they’ll sort it out. Lovely interior and super close to campus. Every meal looks tasty and unique. this place has great values, a great mission, and great employees. highly recommend.

The food is excellent and amazingly cheap. My complaint is that I never know when they're open. No hours are listed here on Google. The phone number goes to a recording every time I try it, which does not tell you the hours. A few times they've been closed when the sign on the door says they're open. What gives?

I had the best experience! The staff were wonderful and very responsive. The food was excellent- I got the southwest chipotle chicken bowl and it was delicious warmed up. I really recommend every table if you are looking for a nice spot to hangout with friends and eat, especially if your a Berkeley student!

top_reviews.content:
You've got to try Original Pollo in Berkeley! It's a quiet, understated restaurant that serves good, cheap food in a nice eating environment.

I love the cozy, old-fashioned vibes. They really suit this diner, which focuses mostly on serving classic, familiar favorites. Everything is simple and simply delightful!

A little bit of money takes you a long way at this small restaurant. Despite the affordable price, this diner does not skimp on quality and serves some of the best burgers and hot dogs in town.

A wonderful place to get breakfast. The staffs here are friendly, professional, and will welcome you like a family. True to a classical breakfast dinner, the food is delicious, the service is excellent, cost is reasonable. 10/10 would recommend. (The breakfast sausages are amazing!)

This place is more like labor of love than a way for an owner to get rich—a community resource. Reasonable prices, yummy satisfying food, and a welcoming atmosphere. Bad reviews for this place are more a reflection of rotten entitlement in a reviewer than an issue with the restaurant. It’s a diner with amazing taste. Understand that and you’ll walk out happy every time. Just want to thank the proprietor and staff for keeping the soul of Berkeley alive. We as customers need to love and patronize these kinds of special places before they all disappear and turn into fast-casual chains.

Attentive service, great prices for the area, excellent quality. I really enjoy a great neighborhood spot, and Pollo's is exactly that. Interesting blend of Mexican, American breakfast and burgers, and Greek. Best breakfast burrito I've ever had.

Got the bacon cheeseburger and made it a double. It was perfectly cooked; both the burger and bacon. My partner got a steak burger with fries it is huge for the price. I suggest adding cheese to it. Very large portion of fresh very hot fries. I’m the picture I added that is only half the fries. I had the rest with my burger. Can’t wait to try other food here

Definitely going to be my new favorite breakfast spot. I'm going to head back up here for lunch and dinner as well. I'm sure the food will be just as good.
Top notch Mexican food. The steak in the carne asada fajita was delicious. Tortas were excellent too. I dare say this Mexican restaurant is best in the area.

We loved this place! I spent some time searching out places to eat on our SF spring break trip and was very satisfied with our dinner. You would walk right by this place if you didn’t know it was there. Small but cozy restaurant with great atmosphere. You could tell all their food was fresh. Everything was well seasoned and so delicious! Would definitely go back 10/10

Great food and atmosphere. Best quesabirrias in SF. Good variety of options!

Try their quesabirrias and fajita plate.

This place has a nice cozy vibe, so intimate that you can even see your food being made in the kitchen from some tables. Definitely a great place to go solo or on a date but probably not for larger parties.

I ordered the carne asada fajitas but wasn’t impressed. They were too chewy for my liking. The tortillas, warm, thick, and with a nice texture, helped make up for it. Also, $20 for all that food is pretty solid.

The service and atmosphere were good enough that I’ll definitely be here again to order something else! I’m grateful to have great places like this so close by.

top_reviews.content: I loved that the menu happened to be all vegetarian when we went. The fact that they have a seasonal rotating menu will also definitely keep us coming back. The mushroom bolognese sauce was so rich and filled with umami. I didn’t take a picture of the saffron poached pears as I took it home to eat but I really enjoyed it - the flavors were very reminiscent of the Indian dessert Srikhand. There’s limited seating so it felt a little loud and crowded inside but I did enjoy the open kitchen concept.

My favorite restaurant in the bay, maybe anywhere. I lived around the corner for years up until last April. Sfizio has become mine and my partner’s favorite date spot and it holds a significant memory in our relationship. The food is consistent and high quality. No frills, amazing seasonal menu with awesome flavor. The staff has always been incredible and accommodating. I’ve probably eaten at Sfizio over 20 times in the last few years and even though I live far away now I try to find time to go back it’s that good. So happy for you guys at Sfizio and hope your success continues. 💕

A true local gem! They rotate through 2-3 pastas, all hand made in house, with fresh flavors. The roasted carrots were surprisingly really good! Really small space though and food can take a small while to come especially during busy dinner hours.

Super cute Italian restaurant with delicious food. My friends and I got an app, pastas, dessert and drinks for less than $50/pp. Absolutely delicious food and I would gladly come back the next time I’m in Oakland.

This was a phenomenal experience, every single dish was a perfect blend of the familiar and the new, the service was excellent Darius was charming and thoughtful. No notes 10/10 and for less than 20$ an entree?? 11/10

top_reviews.content:
Wife & I stayed here to experience The Graduate line of hotels.  Stayed there a couple of days after New Year's day, and it wasn't busy at all.  The weather was rainy 🌧, but didn't hinder the overall positive experience.  The lobby has a vintage feel, and the plants and decor was nice and cozy.  I liked the painting of Marshawn Lynch, next to the elevators.   The staff was helpful and friendly.

The Henry's restaurant and pub wasn't busy.  My guess was that is was raining, and it was just days after the New Year.  The bartender was helpful and patient.  She made a nice mocktail 🍸 .  We ordered the buffalo wings and waffle fries, both of which were tasty and an adequate portion for sharing.  They have several TVs 📺 to catch the sporting games.

We even went the next morning for breakfast, and had breakfast burrito 🌯 and pancakes 🥞.   The portions are large, and the food was enjoyable.

There are a lot of one-start reviews. I didn't believe them. I was wrong. I should have.

Waited 50 minutes for chips and guac. Seriously. The simplest freaking thing to get out of the kitchen, right. Burger took a good 40 minutes to come out.

The front of the house is pleasant, and they seem like nice people. But the kitchen tempo is glacial.

Slow service, server knew nothing about the menu, got my order wrong (wrong kind of salad). My roast beef sandwich came with a pitiful amount of what seemed like boiled meat, no au jus, and the bread was incredibly stale mixed with a wet core!

Update: 1/24/2026- yeah umm super lame. Tried again, bad decision. Is there a zero star option? 6/9/2025- yeah even worse now. They have real trouble with consistency here and are very short staffed most of the time with inexperienced people (not surprising in a college town). Change the management to something more sustainable. Update: 3/6/25- after 2 years of monthly visits in 2023-2025, Henry’s continues to be on the decline.  Sorry to say but the kitchen sucks. I was a Cal student and have a lot of nostalgic memories of this place, but that’s no excuse. Fire the chef! (Old review) All very standard pub food served by a very Berkeley mix of mid-lifers and students. It's a nice place to meet friends.

We ordered 4 drinks! The kitchen was closed by 8.30 p.m. so we didn't get to try the food there. Cocktails are so disappointed! Beers are meh....But the service was amazing! We honestly told the bartender, Greg, that we didn't like the drink so we kept trying. I like the service, the atmosphere, the cleanest bar! I thought drinks are really good prices compared with most bars in Berkeley. They served espresso in the morning from 7 a.m. to 10 a.m. with pastries. If you are looking for somewhere nice and peaceful in the morning. This is your place.

Curry puffs were good, maybe a little small.  Not sure I’d do them again for $14 (four small puffs). Fun for a family of four I’d say (and good flavor).

Outside patio with dogs was wonderful. They brought them a bowl without me asking. 🥰

Very pleased with my meal and full but not gross as I leave. 🤙

I have been meaning to try this place for a while and it did not disappoint. Located in a beautiful white store front the food is just as good as the whole aesthetic of the restaurant.

I got Khao soi curry and a seafood noodle dish. It was fast delicious and fresh.

The service also was incredible. Totally mom and pop vibe where everyone hustles, is friendly and delivers just a great experience.

I would definitely come back.

Super clean. Super tasty. I ordered the green curry and it was amazing!! It has eggplant and green beans along with a protein. Everything was cooked just right. And the flavor was sooo good. I appreciated that the chef brought out the food. Highly recommend!!

i don’t even know where to start i love LTK so much. LTK has been my favorite restaurant for YEARS (a title i do not use lightly) and i always look forward to dining here when i’m in town. i have tried many of their dishes over the years and every single one has been absolutely delicious. portions are large and easy to share so best to bring a group so you can try as many of their appetizers and entrees as possible. (don’t miss their thai iced tea—both the regular and the coconut milk version—and their roti desserts!) i wish i could provide recommendations but it’s impossible to choose, anything you order will be great and trust that you’re going to want to come back and try everything else.

the service is also amazing, the owner boua is so kind and friendly and never fails to brighten my day. do NOT sleep on LTK!!

This place has been a go to for YEARS (since high school). Our family has experienced both dine in and take out, and without fail, every single time, they have been reliable and consistent. The family that runs this place are the most friendly and generous people. They greet us with nice chatter during every visit, even if it’s just picking up our meal. Our family has ordered so many times, we even have the “Shane special”, which is the specific way my dad orders his curry. Our go tos include: the pad thai, pad kee mao, the many assortments of curries (which I appreciate that you can choose your own spice level), and the larb. The drinks are also delicious, especially the Thai tea. This place is so good, that it has become the standard for Thai restaurants for our family. 1000/10 would recommend.

My favorite place in the area. Specials are always fantastic (I particularly love the seafood!), as is the regular menu. High quality home cooked food that never disappoints. Friendly and fast service.

Really friendly waitress… she’s always in a great mood.
Great flavors. The pa-nang curry is amazing!!
Have gone in on Saturday nights ~6 and have never had trouble getting a table.
Take out is also large portions and packaged well.

We came here for dinner and had a great meal! We ordered the Thai iced tea to drink, the Lao sausages as an appetizer, and the pad see ew with beef, phao larb, and yellow curry with chicken as mains. Everything was good, and the service was excellent! The spice levels here are no joke, so definitely stay below levels 2-3. The owner is super nice, and she even explained the differences between Laotian and Thai cuisine to us!

top_reviews.content: This is really a hike in the wall! Lovely atmosphere, boutique like setting (since the max capacity is prob 25 pax?). Everything we ordered is so delicious and beautifully presented. I love the sake too. The sashimi is very fresh and I would definitely recommend that if u plan on dinning here.

Butterfish is in a league of its own—simply the single greatest sushi experience I have ever had. From the moment we walked in, the staff brought incredible warmth, authenticity, and passion to the table, taking the time to explain every single dish in rich detail.

Every item on the menu hit a home run:

Albacore Melody ($19.00): Remarkably fresh, perfectly balanced, and melted in the mouth.

Island Scallops ($19.00): Delicately sweet with an unbeatable, velvety texture.

Escolar Tapa ($15.95): Rich, buttery perfection—easily one of the standout bites of the night.

Sushi and Sashimi 12-piece ($59.00): A masterclass in knife work and quality. Every piece was exceptionally fresh and thoughtfully presented.

Kani Real Crab Handroll ($10.95): Generously stuffed with real crab that truly shone through.

Sapporo ($6.95): Crisp, cold, and the ideal pairing to round out an unforgettable meal.

I honestly never realized just how incredible a dining experience like this could be. Butterfish has officially set the bar so high that it has completely ruined sushi anywhere else for me. If you are in Berkeley, do yourself a favor and eat here!

This place is incredible in food, service, and atmosphere. Such amazing quality fish and delicious dishes.

My favorite was their hand rolls and the hirame usuzukuri (like a carpaccio). Even their green tea was made well, not bitter at all - so smooth. I dont think you could get anything wrong here.

Came here last-minute looking for a good sushi place, and it was amazing. Atmosphere was indeed omakase-esque as other reviews state, really small and intimate. Sat at the bar and watched the chef at work, which I would highly recommend. I don't think you would go wrong at all ordering anything off the menu, everything we had was delicious. Portions on the salmon avocado roll were large, and there was never any padding for space in a roll with extra rice... just more fish. A bit on the pricey side, but very much worth it and really close to the best sushi I've had.
Best Sushi Experience and Fish quality ever! Highlight in Berkeley! This is a restaurant you should not miss! Amazing people, atmosphere and food!!!

top_reviews.content: I saw all the good reviews about the chicken sandwich and was surprised to see people love it even though it’s a cafe at a museum. I decided to try it out but place is mid tbh. This was NOT the “best ever chicken sandwich” as it’s named. Chicken was a bit hard and overcooked and the fries were hard as well. Definitely not worth it.

My friend and I had a somewhat difficult time locating the restaurant as we didn't think the directions were clear, especially with it being my first time to the museum. Mid-level? What's mid-level? There was an elevator to the upper level from the level we were on but you had to go down stairs a level to get to the restaurant. So, what level were we on when we came in?

Anyway, once we entered I noticed there was no table service so we had to decide what we wanted before we paid at the register.  The line was short and there was a tender agel child, possibly 8 yrs old or so in front of us with some adults ahead of her. I assumed she was with them and not unattended. The cashier at the second register said next customer but said her register wasn't working and Michelle Mc Queen, who was at the first register, said we had jumped the line. So we went back and Michelle told the customer behind us that the second register, where we just were could take the order if paying by credit card so all of a sudden, the register was working. Hmmm...

The food came fairly quickly. I ordered the deviled eggs, excuse me, the World Famous Deviled Eggs. To us, the filling was under seasoned. I had the fried pork chop with macaroni and chees and collard greens. The pork chop was salty and hammered. It was extremely dry. The Mac & Cheese had an ok flavor but the macaroni was mushy. The greens we good.

My friend had the Fried Chicken Sandwich with fries. He offered me a piece of his sandwich and the coleslaw on it was good and needed to offset the overly salty chicken. I didn't try the fries but my friend said they were salty.

None of the fried food was oily but it was very crispy.

Michelle saw me in passing delivering a meal to a table and wanted to know how we liked the food. I said I would speak with her after. She stopped by and I told her the pork chop was overcooked and salty and, giving her the benefit of the doubt, the macaroni perhaps had been held too long(instead of being overcooked to begin with)as the noodles were mushy. My friend and I told the chicken was salty but the coleslaw was good. She pleasantly and immediately offered to re-cook the meal but I declined. To her credit, she didn't act offended or was offensive but wanted to satisfy a customer. Her attitude alone would make me want to go back. Plus  I do understand things happen in the kitchen. The cook could have been distracted and perhaps lost time how long the pork chop had been cooking as a thin cut chop doesn't take long to overcook. If something isn't right with the food, I would go back as long as the food isn't horrible or the staff is dismissive. The food wasn't horrible and her attitude was perfect.

When first walking in, the host weren’t at the, “Wait to be seated” sign and made a smart remark when my mother was walking in. We were seated about 2-3 minutes after. I ordered two orange juices that were priced $4.5 on the menu, but was charged $5. That was one thing. My food came out in a decent amount of time, the waffles were great! But the white meat chicken I ordered with it, looked like a chunk was cut out of it, fired, and then served to me; almost like it was a scarp piece of meat. Catalina was my waitress, took my payment for the meal, and brought me back the wrong receipt. Now, I wouldn’t be that worried about it, but the receipt was an AMEX purchase of $8.00, and mine was a cash payment of $55.00. So that bothered me when I realized what the waitress had done. My food I would give a 4/5 because of the chicken with my waffles. 3/5 over all for the service.

Start to finish delicious! We used to go to her spot in the Fillmore District SF called Gussie's Chicken & Waffles. Had the Bloody Mary's Revenge and the basil ginger soda, deviled eggs, fried chicken & sweet potato waffles, and the fried chicken sandwich. You can run & tell everybody that this is the spot! DJ Mark Divita during Sunday brunch gave us the perfect musical pairings.

We came to Town Fare for the first time after finding out about the restaurant from the Bay Area KQED check please show. We were thrilled to try their chicken sandwich which came with breast meat and some coleslaw. The meat was very tender, cooked to perfection, the coleslaw had really nice flavors, and the buns were good too. The mac and cheese was also very good; the cheese had good flavor. The restaurant has a very open, clean, organic modern atmosphere. Many seating options inside and outside. The staff were nice. They have street parking around the museum and a museum parking garage. 10/10 Recommend.

More of a grab and go atmosphere but they are fast and friendly to me, and the condiment section is loaded with good stuff like free sesame seeds, teriyaki sauce, Japanese spice, Sriracha, shoyu etc. I like this for a nice light meal for some protein and energy after a work out or so.
Fantastic flavors and a great deal. Loved the chicken teriyaki and the miso soup.

Ive been coming here for years. My favorites are the spicy tofu/ grilled salmon/ ahi tuna triangles/onigiri. They also have an ahi tuna plate (over rice) which i get as well. If you get a set of 3-4 onigiris it comes with edamame. My orders have always been made quickly and prices are affordable.

In all my travels, I look for what I call "happy food."  Happy food for me is healthy, nutritious, tasty, nicely prepared, and served by smiling people in a clean environment.  Oori exceeded all my happy food requirements and then took me for a ride through food blissfulness with each bite.  I had chicken teriyaki, grilled salmon, and spicy tuna triangles.  On the side, I complimented it with miso soup and ginger. Each flavor was distinct and made my taste buds ooh, ahh, and wow for more.  I'll be back here for more without question. I felt like I was dining at a 5-star restaurant and found the food reasonably priced.

The double unagi rice triangle features large pieces of unagi.   The short rib plate is not really short rib but small bites of beef nuggets.  I prefer edamame boiled rather than wok fry as the edamame tends to be greasy with wok fry.

top_reviews.content: Delightful family-owned restaurant featuring Peruvian-Italian cuisine, though I have only sampled the Italian side of the menu, including different kinds of pizza. Delicious food. Attentive service. Intimate feeling. Offers seating both inside and on the sidewalk. Very hard not to love this neighborhood restaurant.

Casa Barotti is a lovely family owned Peruvian-Italian restaurant with delicious food, cozy vibes, and friendly service. I ordered the pesto rigatoni with chicken milanesa, and for me, the chicken was the star! Great flavor and texture.

First time having pizza focaccia and they are incredible! Will definitely be back if I'm in the area. Plenty of tables and the staff are very nice.

Mushroom & sausage focaccia - fluffy soft with crispy edges, garlicky, and full of flavor.

Garlic bread - I'd skip it next time to try another pizza.

Second time getting focaccia here and just have to spread the word on how absolutely delicious the food is! The focaccia is soft with a nice crunchy bottom and the vegetarian flavors are excellent. Today we had the arrabiata and it did have a bit of a kick, nice tomato paste flavor and such a lovely texture! Also enjoyed an avocado caprese sandwich- vegetarian and very beautiful with pale green tomatoes, avocados and arugula paired with mozzarella. The service is wonderful and the dining area is very cute and clean! Prices are reasonable. Will come back for dinner and drinks at some point!
We love the pizzas! They also have a great roast chicken, which makes for a delicious family dinner. Ingredients are high quality and the atmosphere is sweet.

reviews_snippets.content: "Very tasty food, good atmosphere and good service."
"Nice choice of pizza slices, was good & affordable, $5 I paid for my slice."
"The Lord truly gave some people AMAZING gifts and talent!"

top_reviews.content:
Stopped by to pickup some takeout of the Salt & Pepper chicken wings (excellent and crispy!!), string beans (nice crunch with a slight spice), sweet & sour prawns (flavorful but not overly salty), and shrimp fried rice (delicious and not oily!)

Staff was kind and prompt, and the chef even came out from the back to say hi and thank us for stopping by! Love getting to support a local neighborhood business like this ❤️

Hunan Village on Grand Avenue is an incredible spot for a fast, flavorful lunch, and their Kung Pao Tofu is absolutely perfect. The tofu is cooked beautifully and comes drenched in a generous amount of savory, bold sauce that packs the perfect flavor punch.The service turnaround here is remarkably fast. They are clearly used to a steady stream of people walking in on them all day, yet they never miss a beat. They always make sure to send you away with plenty of extra sauces and condiment packets in your bag. Plus, they have a fully stocked refrigerator with a great drink selection, making it incredibly easy to grab your entire lunch all in one convenient spot.

Food and service was phenomenal. We were trying to catch a quick bite before the movies at Grand lake on a Friday night and it was just perfect and convenient. We ordered the Broccoli and beef, salt and pepper wings, and vegetable fried rice. Highly recommend. Truly a gem of a place!
A 10/10 experience. The prawns with mixed vegetables lunch special was tasty and a great value. I left satisfied, and the hostess/server/cashier was very friendly.

Food is good average Chinese American menu the interior design is minimal and sedate and very clean. My complaint is that the odor of the cleaning products they use competes with the aroma of their food. Better to pickup than stay in if you don't like Pine-sol or  whatever that smell comes from.

reviews_snippets.content: "Great food, good portion size, clean interior, friendly staff"
"The two of us enjoyed a chicken and prawn lunch special with soup and tea."
"Amazing dishes, great flavors, very kind folks running the restaurant."

name: Collina
address: 1550 Hyde St, San Francisco, CA 94109, United States

google.name: Collina
google.address: 1550 Hyde St, San Francisco, CA 94109, United States

top_reviews.content:
We ordered the seasonal truffle pasta and it was absolutely delicious, the truffle flavor was gentle and well balanced, not overwhelming, with fresh truffles that really elevated the dish. We also tried the chicken, which was good, though slightly on the salty side but topping was so good. The desserts were also tasty and a great way to finish the meal.
The atmosphere is calm and quiet, perfect for a date night. Tables are a bit close to each other, but it never felt too loud.
Overall, I would definitely recommend it as a romantic spot with very delicious food.

I was pretty excited to try this place out since I live in the neighborhood and heard good things about the place; unfortunately quite disappointed by both the service and food.

We ordered a salad, cacio e pepe, and the lasagna. The salad came out pretty quickly; nothing surprising or special about the salad, just what you would expect. Afterwards, we waited for over 45 mins to finally get our cacio e pepe that 1) came out in a cracked dish as shown in the pic (which I think is not to be expected from a restaurant at this pricing and reputation), 2) it was super salty; I’ve tried cacio e pepe in other Italian places in SF. This one was way too salty. Not sure if it was a mistake or from sprinkling too much salt on it before giving it to us. After the cacio e pepe was served, the lasagna came out after 20 mins. We ordered a simple salad and 2 pasta dishes and the total time to get all of our dishes out was over an hr which I think is pretty ridiculous.

Next the service was not great. Our server ( I’m a bit blurry on his name) checked in on us not a single time during the entire service when I noticed he was checking in on other tables much more often. I’m not sure if it was some racism going on here because we were the only Asian ppl there, but didn’t feel welcomed and served right.

One last thing; our table was situated in a weird position where we can see and hear the guy sitting on the bar eating his dish. Sometimes crumbs will fall from the bar to our table which is a bit of a ick…

So overall, disappointed and will not go again.

Excellent experience. We started with some focaccia and olive oil; it was good. We took the waiter's recommendation and had a tomino cheese special as appetizer with some pieces of toast; it was quite succulent. For main courses, we once again chose the special, a truffle pasta. The price was hefty ($55!), but it was absolutely delicious. We also had the ricotta gnocchi, which was saucy and rich. We finished the evening with some tiramisu, which was alright.

The service was mostly fine, except for some minor hiccups. The ambience is fine too. We spent $160 for two after tax before tip.

Collina is the “little sister” of Seven Hills, and you can definitely see the same polished Italian influence in a more casual, cozy neighborhood setting. The star for me was the 50-layer lasagna — incredibly thin layers, crispy edges, rich meat sauce, and a beautiful green sauce underneath. The rosemary focaccia was also excellent: fluffy inside, golden and crisp on top, and perfect with olive oil. We finished with tiramisu, which was light, creamy, and not overly sweet.

Cozy, approachable, and a great spot for handmade Italian comfort food. I’d come back for that lasagna alone!

Service was great!

Second to NONE! My fiancé and I found this place on Resy (now on open table) when we were looking for restaurants in sf (we are visitors). Liam, our server, and Ashton, the manager, made sure our experience was enjoyable, personal, and intentional. Our favorites from the night were the blue shell crab for him and the scallops for me (see pictures attached). These were some of the best scallops I have ever had. I wish this restaurant was in our hometown so we could eat here regularly! I would definitely recommend making a reservation for this spot as it is a smaller restaurant and it fills up quick. This is a place you don’t want to miss! LOVE LOVE LOVED IT!!!!

reviews_snippets.content: "Wonderful service, staff and the waitress recommended a great bottle of wine!"
"Great Italian restaurant, food and wine were really yummy"
"For mains, I ordered the lasagna and my partner ordered the mushroom gnocchi."

name: Fermentation Lab
address: 1700A Post St, San Francisco, CA 94115, United States

google.name: Fermentation Lab
google.address: 1700A Post St, San Francisco, CA 94115, United States

top_reviews.content:
Came for the Wednesday Prime Rib special for $65 and made it just in time for the happy hour, which was $2-$4 off the original price, so I ordered even more items. The deviled eggs had four pieces(2 kinds), the bacon marmalade was rich and flavorful and the smoked salmon was quite salty. The calamari misto was lightly battered and I loved that it came with a mix of artichoke heart, shrimp, calamari, onions, and jalapenos. I could taste the umani of the duck fat fries. The uni pasta got the creaminess down, and the squid ink pasta was cooked well, but the uni flavor was very light and the flavors weren't as bold as I had expected. The prime rib was tender and the sides were decent. The chefs amuse bouche and the churro were the cherry on top for the prime rib special.

With everything that was ordered, I was worried that I didn't have enough table space, but all the items were spaced out enough to fit everything a the right time. The Fermentation Lab is the perfect place for a date for those that appreciate a lovely atmosphere, welcoming service, vibrant drinks and beautifully plated dishes. I probably wouldn't come for just the prime rib special, but I would love to try other items on the menu. I wasn't expecting any screens, but they had two projectors and a tv playing the USA vs Bosnia World Cup game so that was a pleasant surprise!

Cocktail bar with pretty delicious food!!! I really enjoyed my experience here overall. A beautiful interior and good vibes. Everything on the menu was priced a little high, but the quality was worth it. Every cocktail was good!

FYI - Yelp advertised that this restaurant has a "no tipping policy"... but the tablet indeed asked for a tip when we checked out. Service was great, so I didn't mind... but just a heads uo!!!

+ Uni Pasta (5/5): MY FAVORITE! Squid ink pasta was perfectly al dente and carried the creamy sauce so well. Very decadent, full of flavor, and smooth. They added a good amount of uni for the price.

+ Makgeoli Braised Bossam (4/5): Very small portion, but the pork was cooked well and was flavorful. A different take on bossam, so not very traditional.

+ Tea Leaf Salad (2/5): Lacked so much flavor. Vegetables were fresh, but the tea leaf dressing truly did not taste authentic. I would not recommend.

+ Sake Flight (5/5): SO GOOD! Bang for your buck. I loved the variety of sake and the presentation. A lot of these I've never even heard before.

Easy self seating on a Saturday afternoon for two, cocktails are solid but at market rate for this area. My matcha martini was well made and those duck fat fries were damn good! Brussel sprouts were as expected.... lots of standard bar fare and happy hour prices.  Fast service, we would definitely go back. If you love beer, there are an array of good local brewed choices.

Take this with a massive grain of salt as we came during happy hour and got the specials. So, their regular menu might be great. Everything felt like it was overcompensating. The oysters were hidden under mounds of salt. Good wet wings still have a crisp to them, but these had a "mush" to them. The calamari was good and our server was great.

May 2026:
Came here on a Sunday night and was pleasantly surprised that Happy hour was all night.

From the happy hour menu, tried the Korean chicken wings. They were tasty. Could have been crispier. Perhaps the wings were precooked.

Also tried the tea leaf salad. I liked the salad. Had tasty dressing. Liked the fried garbanzo beans.

We also shared the Korean noodle soup. We had to send it back because the first time we got it, there were at least 6 clams that didn't open up. They remade the dish and it was much better. Oddly too that the first time we got the dish, the broth was a little thick. When they remade it, the broth consistency was much better.

Service was a little slow but very friendly.

reviews_snippets.content: "Not an obvious location but the service, food and atmosphere are incredible."

top_reviews.content: I love 4 Dreams.  We discovered this restaurant some months back. Always looking for good Indian food and everything we've tried here had been good or really great, and also often interesting and unique. The restaurant is  pleasant and so far usually quiet which is nice,  with comfortable booths and also chair options.  Service also has been friendly and staff have been helpful.  I gave 4 stars on service because sometimes they seem a little slow before taking the order,  but they have a big menu sothey may just be giving people time.

Amazing 10/10 best Indian I’ve had since I was born. I will take my family here every single time I do see them. I would like to thank the entire staff for an experience I will cherish for the rest of my days. 4 dreams you’re are the best thing that’s happened to me in my entire culinary life. The sauce is thick the chicken is melt in your mouth. The pakoras are perfectly fried pillows of magic. Thank you x4!!!
“Such an amazing experience! The food was incredibly tasty and made with so much care. Staff was kind and friendly too. Wishing this place lots of success!”

4dreams in the East Bay Area offers an incredible blend of Nepali and Indian cuisine, with each dish bursting with authentic flavors. The cozy atmosphere enhances the dining experience, making it perfect for gatherings. Definitely a must-visit for food lovers seeking something unique

WOW!  Just WOW!  We were in town for a show and this restaurant showed up with great reviews and seemed to offer some different options.  It was AWESOME.  I'm a little burnt out on curry because I've been cooking a lot myself lately and so decided to go with the Nepalese options.  Just wonderful. I had the Chicken Choila appetizer and it was off the charts. Unique flavors of spiciness, mint, citrus, smoked chicken, red onion.  Reminded me a little of Larb in a Thai restaurant.  Also got the Chicken Keema Noodles.  Also tremendous.  Savory chopped chicken, soft noodles in a spicy oil sauce.  My partner had Nepali Thali and she raved...said it was one of the best Thali she's ever had. We met the owner...super nice and humble guy.  The service was impeccable and very attentive. My partner is GF and they were able to answer all preventative questions.  There's nothing fancy about the restaurant...just really great food.

top_reviews.content: I love thai taste kitchen & you will too. Atmosphere outside is superb & the food was hella delectable. We got Khao soy & the BBQ pork skewers & I will be back for everything else

Large group friendly!!  They were super polite & easy going about our split checks.  The food was amazing!!  Fresh, delicious, & super cute.  My vegan friend had a great selection, & I had chicken so soft it felt melty delicious.  This restaurant is worth going to!!

The Pad Se Ew was an amazing texture and flavor and a crisp Singha went nicely with the meal. The mango sticky rice was also pretty incredible.

We sat on the back patio on the edge of it where they walked past to take out the garbage. I would absolutely recommend changing the route of how you take the garbage out because I got some really bad whiffs of smell while we were eating when the garbage was being taken out right next to our table.

Stopped by for dinner and was seated right away. The staff is super helpful and answered all the questions we had. They were attentive and friendly. Everything we ordered was amazing and they had great portions to share. We fell in love with their mango sticky rice too. Coming back here to try more dishes!

I would have previously given this spot 5 stars, but most recent take out order had meat in the pescatarian dish. This is really concerning and upsetting. The pumpkin curry was also pretty bland and a very small portion. Quality seems to have gone down from a couple years ago, disappointed.

top_reviews.content: Amazing place. Their tacos taste similar as the ones on Mexico. Amazing salsa and seasoning, they're actually spicy and thats the point. The carnitas and lengua tacos where the best tacos I had in a long time. Not the greatest ambient, but for a casual meal, beers n food is a great option.

The restaurant is right across the street from our hotel and it was really worth it.  I ordered a quesabirra taco(you have to order how many you want so it is al la carte) elote  rice and beans with mango aqua fresco! My husband had two bean rice and cheese burritos! They also gave us 3 bags of chips with salsa which we weren't expecting.  The rice and beans were ok, but the corn was the best it was so good! The quesabirra was so good as well I should of ordered 2. We took our food to go to eat at the hotel since it was small in there and really loud with the customers inside.  That means it's good food! Thank you to the staff for making great food!

This Mexican restaurant is a small, cozy, and relatively clean spot, perfect for a casual meal. It's not too pricey, and the friendly, welcoming staff add to the positive experience. I ordered the Mar Y Tierra Chicken Burrito, and it was absolutely delicious, especially for the price I paid. Overall, it's a great value for a tasty meal, and I'd definitely recommend it for anyone looking for good Mexican food without breaking the bank.

Had a quesabirria & my bf got a breakfast burrito for our first morning in San Francisco for Valentine’s Day weekend. Burrito had a nice crisp too it, tortillas were good, consommé needed just a bit more salt/flavor but easily adjusted. Authentic Mexican menu, clean, & good music.

Holy chit Chuy! That was the best dang super burrito I've had in the Bay Area. Hit all the spots. Really uniform and well packed rivaling chiplote. Perfect proportions, good price. No guessing game at the end, like did that little piece of extra meat cost me 2 more dollars. I wanted another as soon as I was done with that one! Definitely a great crave spot. Can't wait to try the whole menu. Do not change a thing at the post street location. I was there on 8-7-2026 at 4:30pm. Whoever that chef is, is excellent! The waitress was great too. Made sure I had everything I needed before I left with my to go order. Seemed very caring. The decor is beautiful too. Thought those were epoxy tables with all those beautiful colorful flowers. A lot of neat details in there. Thank you for the wonderful supper, and beautiful atmosphere!

top_reviews.content:
Absolutely Phenomenal Pizza & Vibes!

If you are looking for the absolute best pizza in Berkeley, look no further than Red Tomato Pizza House. From the moment you walk in, you're treated like family, and that's all thanks to the incredible owners, Buler and Go. They are some of the most welcoming, cordial, and genuinely friendly people you will ever meet, and their passion for what they do completely shines through in the food and the atmosphere.
The food itself is spectacular, starting with a crust that is perfectly executed to give you that ideal, authentic crunch with just the right touch of char. It’s never overly doughy, providing the perfect base for their fresh ingredients. You can instantly taste the quality of their top-tier three-blend mozzarella cheese and toppings that are prepared fresh in-house daily. Whether you are looking for a killer combination pizza, a smoky BBQ chicken pie, or need excellent gluten-free or vegan options, they have completely mastered it all.
To top it all off, the place is incredibly clean, the service is lightning-fast, and they have an awesome beer selection to pair with your meal. On the weekends, the downtown location is perfect for catching great live music right outside. Buler and Go have built a true gem in Berkeley with incredible food, wonderful hospitality, and a warm, homey feel. I’ll definitely be a frequent regular here!
Ordered a pizza to be delivered... vegan BBQ. It arrived almost completely uncooked. Dough was raw and even cold. Inedible, and for $50.

I had a really disappointing experience here. I ordered a calzone and garlic knots, and almost immediately after eating them I started feeling sick to my stomach. Within a short time I had to rush to the bathroom and ended up throwing up. It was honestly a terrible experience.

Beyond that, the food itself was not good at all. The calzone and garlic knots tasted very bland and seemed very unfresh. There was almost no flavor, and the texture made it seem like the ingredients had been sitting around for a while rather than being freshly prepared.

When you’re paying for restaurant food, you expect it to at least taste fresh and be made with quality ingredients. Unfortunately this was the complete opposite of that. The whole experience left me feeling sick and extremely disappointed.

I rarely write negative reviews, but people should know what they might be getting. I definitely will not be returning.

Absolutely delicious!! This was my second time coming here and I got a 10 inch cheese pizza both times and it was wonderful! The ingredients are fresh and honestly just taste really good. The staff is also really nice! 10/10 amazing!

I ordered a pizza & potato skins to go. We ordered the combination pizza. Oh my goodness! I regretted not ordering a bigger pie. It was so good! The sauce,  it too zingy or acidic or overpowering ( my pet peeve) We will definitely come back & order the other flavors. The potato skins were delicious. The only thing I suggest for those is to add a sprinkle of chives and to have the option of sour cream or ranch for dipping. The food was excellent. One of the best pizzas I have ever had! Thank you!

reviews_snippets.content: "Loved the vibes, wonderful & friendly service, food was DELISH!!!!!!!!"

top_reviews.content: We had such a great experience at Cenaduría Elvira! Everything is authentic and inspired by the traditional flavors of Jalisco, Mexico. We ordered the enchiladas, tacos, and a torta, and every dish was fresh, flavorful, and prepared perfectly. The portions were generous, and you could really taste the quality and authenticity in every bite. Everything was so delicious, and we can’t wait to come back and try more of the menu. Definitely recommend!

Please don’t change a single thing about this restaurant. It is absolutely perfect just the way it is.

The food is beyond delicious. I honestly can’t remember the last time I experienced such authentic flavors—it truly felt like traveling back to the roots of traditional cuisine. This place is a real gem.

I was hoping it would live up to my expectations, and it exceeded every one of them. It’s so refreshing to find a restaurant that honors and preserves its traditions instead of trying to reinvent them.

A special thank you to Eduardo, who made our experience even more memorable. He was incredibly kind, attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. His hospitality was exceptional and made us feel genuinely welcomed.

I only wish I had the opportunity to meet and thank the owners personally for creating such a special place. You can truly feel the love, passion, and authenticity in every detail.

I cannot wait to come back. Please don’t change a thing—this restaurant is perfect exactly as it is.

I decided to try this new restaurant out after hearing about it on social media. They started in the owner's backyard during the peak of COVID, and now they have their own brick-and-mortar restaurant in Oakland! The tostadas raspadas are shipped directly from Mexico! Of course, I had to try one. I elected for the Tostada Raspada Sensilla, and I also tried a Rajas Sope (not pictured). Both were delicious. I should have asked for cheese on my raspada, but I was able to add some Mexican sour cream, along with the pickled onions and radishes provided at every table. My partner got the raspada with chicken and loved it. We went on a Friday evening, and there was no wait. The service was friendly, attentive, and the restaurant was clean. I’ll definitely be back when I’m in the area again.

The food here is AMAZING! I’ve lived in Oakland for 10 months now and it’s my first time eating here. And oh. My. God.

I 10000% recommend. The tostada raspada is a must and the torta ahogado. The staff, especially Jerson,  were extremely friendly and amazing. I don’t know what they put in the frijoles but they did it amazing.

This is my new favorite spot. 11/10 recommend eating here. You won’t regret it

This was our first visit to the Cenaduria Elvira Restaurant in Oakland and looking forward to returning again to try more menu offerings.

During our lunch visit today, we enjoyed staring off with a couple beers, tostada chips & beans, followed by a variety of crispy tacos and a torta ahogada. Everything arrived to the table fast and was delicious!

Our Server and wait staff were very friendly, engaging, and helpful answering our menu questions.

The restaurant had both indoor and outdoor patio seating. The restaurant was nicely decorated and loved the feel with the open kitchen.

We will be back soon!

At first it seemed a bit high until we saw the size of these sandwiches. They were huge with tons of meat and absolutely delicious. Wish we could come back!!

Another great, five star deli in SF. Big menu with many options to choose from. The roast beef, cheese, and jalapeno sandwich I ordered was very tasty. I usually opt for Dutch crunch but the soft roll here was very tasty as well. I’m glad to have found this deli and will definitely be back for more sandwiches.

I tried Salty’s Lavazza coffee for the first time today. The coffee was perfect. The flavor was very smooth, with the right brew strength.
I also tried the avocado toast. The toast was delicious!
The impeccably clean little cafe/sandwich shop is staffed by pleasant, attentive staff.
I noticed a delicious and nutritious looking Cobb salad, and a variety of healthy snack items.
When on Van Ness Ave in SF, go to Salty’s. You will not be disappointed.

10 out of 10. Highly recommend no matter whether you’re just grabbing something quick to go or you wanna dine-in for a bit (like I did). Service was great and the sandwich was even better. I just randomly stopped in for the first time and the guy at the counter was very patient and didn’t rush me to order. Even suggested their best seller.

The sandwich itself was very meaty and the bread was perfect. Better than Subway, Jersey Mikes, Firehouse, etc. Gave a three star for atmosphere because well… there is no atmosphere. You go in, you get your sandwich, and if you want to eat in… there may or may not be a seat for you. Simple, in my opinion.

MUST TRY FOR BREAKFAST OR LUNCH!!! This place was so good. The bfast sandwich with bacon and the maple chipotle sauce was very good. Staff was polite, helpful, and patient with a first time customer. Location was clean with ample seating. Very easy to find and well located. If you are around the federal courthouse and looking for quick, good food, this is a must try!!!

top_reviews.content:
What a great little find in Berkeley! Cali Alley is tucked away in an alley with a cool, laid-back atmosphere and some seriously good food.

We tried the Chef’s Burger, fried chicken sandwich, mac & cheese, and fries, and everything was fantastic. The Chef’s Burger was the standout for me. A juicy brisket burger piled high with hickory-smoked tri-tip, Swiss cheese, crispy onions, pepperoncini, and Thousand Island aioli. Definitely not your average burger! The combination of flavors and textures really worked. The fried chicken sandwich was crispy and flavorful, the mac & cheese was rich and creamy, and the fries were just as good.

What I really liked about Cali Alley is that they take familiar comfort food and give it their own creative twist without overcomplicating things. You can tell there’s some real thought and care behind the menu. The portions are generous, the ingredients taste fresh, and the whole place has a fun, unpretentious neighborhood feel.

Love discovering spots like this. We’ll definitely be back to explore more of the menu. Highly recommend!

Cali Alley is a fantastic spot that’s well worth checking out. One of the things I appreciated most is the variety on the menu—there are plenty of great choices for all tastes, including a solid selection of vegan and vegetarian options.

A couple of things to know before you go: there isn’t a restroom on-site. It’s not a deal breaker by any means, but it’s something to keep in mind. Also, our food took a little while to be prepared, but once it arrived, it was clear the wait was absolutely worth it.

The portions are generous—don’t be surprised if you’re taking home leftovers in a to-go box. Everything we ordered was packed with flavor and incredibly satisfying. The Chef Burger was so good it should honestly be called the “Chef’s Kiss Burger.” The Mac n Cheese is to die for, rich and comforting in all the right ways. And the Mint Limeade was the perfect refreshing complement to the meal—absolutely delicious.

Whether you choose to dine in or order delivery, you won’t be disappointed. Plus, you’re supporting a great small business that clearly takes pride in serving quality food. Highly recommended!

i’ve been going here for years! delicious food! they’ve expanded their menu a lot and i’m really enjoying it. they’ve got options for gluten free and vegetarian too. one of my favorite things about cali alley is that it’s outdoors and dog friendly. such a cute place. staff are very nice too.

i love their prawn bao buns. their mac and cheese and loco moco are also really tasty. eventually i’ll try everything on the menu!

I ordered the chicken and waffles with habanero salsa and it was exquisite. The food came out nice and hot (probably made to order by the sounds of the kitchen?) and was packed with flavor. Well seasoned, cooked beautifully, and not greasy at all. I'm excited to come back and try other offerings on their menu.

*Note that it's outdoor seating only

A cute little corner stop that's full of flavor, and you'd never guess it! This burger had it all, and then some. I'm talking about the chef's burger of course. It was nice and juicy, cooked to perfection (medium being my preferred temperature), and the best part was that there was a surprise pickle! The fries were seasoned well too. House ranch also was a nice touch. We'll be back. Maybe tomorrow.

top_reviews.content: A family friend invited me there and said, “it will be the best meal of your life”. I thought he was joking. He wasn’t. He had ordered lamb shank for us. Apparently you have to order in advance as it takes a few hours to prepare. It was truly incredible. I have lived inManhattan for a few decades and have eaten in top Michelin starred restaurants as well as hole in the wall Pakistani/Indian joints. This lamb shank was heavenly. Only thing i would change is to add option of byob. Would be awesome to be able to bring your wine to dinner here

Warm plates, warm food, warm people
Complimentary chicken hot and sour soup, complimentary tea.

Very tasty and fresh food, this restaurant does not use any frozen ingredient.

Very reasonable priced with most dishes being in $14-$20 range, given that the soup is complimentary as well as the tea, incredible value and taste at $14-$20.

The food service is quick, clean and warm - they even have a warm plate, in winter this is such a nice touch to get food in a warm plate.

The ambiance is cozy, warm home-like, clean and professional.

Very polite staff and owners.

Love that they have a balanced mix of vegetarian and meat-based dishes.

5/5
Really nice mural on the walls, good ventilation, complimentary chai & water, nice staff, the BEST NAAN I HAVE EVER HAD, and great chill music

There are very few restaurants where I find myself venture back to the very next day after trying it for the first time, but Vegan N’ Chicken had me hooked after my first bite.

I was looking for a simple comfort meal after a long day and decided to try a place. It was around 8:30 and most places in the area were closing at 9 but Vegan N’ Chicken happened to be open until 10pm!

When I walked in, I immediately was welcomed with ‘mom and pop’ restaurant vibes. It is a very casual and fairly small restaurant, but it makes for a very comforting experience. You get to seat yourself then they’ll bring you a menu. The menu is simple, but also has everything you’d need. They even have a few seafood dishes! While you wait for your food, you can help yourself to their complimentary soup & hot chai. I’ll admit I have no clue what the soup is, but it is such a great way to start the meal. Especially with some hot chai too!

On day 1 we ordered Lamb Tikka Masala ($14.99), Chana Masala ($9.99), Cheese Naan ($3.99), Rice ($2.99), and Vegetable Samosas ($4.99). The servings were very generous for the price compared to other similar restaurants in Berkeley. We did ask for medium spice level, but it wasn’t spicy enough for us so they brought us a plate of onions, peppers, and cucumbers! The Chana Masala was my favorite bite of the night. It was packed with fragrant spices & the garbanzo beans were so tender. The Lamb Tikka Masala was a little bit sweeter than I am used to, but after mixing in some rice or eating it with the cheese naan it was perfect.

On day 2, we ordered the Papadum ($2.99), Rice ($2.99), Prawn Vindaloo ($17.99), and Chana Masala ($9.99 - we added paneer to it and didn’t confirm how much it was with the paneer). This time we ordered our dishes spicy to see if it was any different. It really was still not spicy at all, but honestly it didn’t bother us. It was a great way to be able to enjoy the dishes in their entirety. The prawns in the vindaloo were fairly large and the portion was perfect for two people! They were also not overcooked & still had a nice bounce when biting into it. The Chana masala with the added paneer was a great combination as well.

Vegan N’ Chicken is honestly a great spot for the college students nearby as well. It’s affordable & could easily be split into two meals even if you just order one dish!

Next time we stop by, we’re going for the biryani!

Discovered the best Indian/Pakistani restaurant in the Berkeley area, and I couldn’t be more impressed. The restaurant was neat and clean, and the owner was incredibly professional and welcoming. He took the time to go over the menu with us and highlight some standout dishes. Our group of six ordered a variety of items, and every single dish was fantastic, with the Gobi Gosht being a particular highlight. You could tell that everything was made with fresh, high quality ingredients, which made a big difference in the flavor. The food was delicious, and the service was outstanding. I’ll definitely be returning for both the amazing food and excellent service. Five stars!

We made a reservation to celebrate a birthday and seated right away.
Cons:
-price... for the amount of food and taste it was pretty expensive. Spent about $250 for 4 people and my husband definitely could have eaten more.
-ambiance... Got a little loud and hard to hear each other without talking really loudly.
Pros:
